newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil council sets May TR discount at 0.95 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil council sets May TR discount at 0.95 pct.

text.p: Brazil's National Monetary Council (CMN) Thursday set the so-called "discount" used for calculating the benchmark Reference Rate (TR) at 0.95 percent for next May, a Finance Ministry official said.
Pedro Parente, the ministry's executive secretary, told reporters the discount in May would be unchanged from April.

The discount is used to calculate the Reference Rate, which determines savings rates and mortgage rates. The TR is based on an average of a basket of Certificates of Deposit (CDs) interest rates minus the discount.
The discount for January has been set at 0.97 percent, for February at 0.96 percent and for March at 0.95 percent. -- Michael Christie, Brasilia newsroom 55-61-2230358
